title: The Melancholy of Slaying Monsters
summary: An MIT Press article exploring the unexpected melancholy and existential weight players feel when slaying monsters in video games, examining how games like Dark Souls and Final Fantasy evoke complex emotions beyond simple triumph.
problem_solved: Explores why players experience unexpected melancholy rather than pure satisfaction when defeating enemies in narrative-driven games.
why_valuable: Offers insight into the emotional complexity of gaming as an art form and how game design creates meaningful emotional experiences beyond surface-level gameplay.
